caption: The image shows a round plate with a decorative border and a detailed central scene. The border consists of a repeating pattern of large, light-colored flowers with multiple petals and dark centers, interspersed with leaves and set against a dark background. The central image depicts a large, multi-story building with many windows and a central cupola or clock tower. In front of the building, there are several figures: two adults, both wearing long coats and hats, are standing with a small child, and another figure can be seen in the background. The scene is framed by trees with dense foliage and a slightly cloudy sky above. The entire image is in grayscale, with various shades of black, white, and gray used to render the details and shading of the composition.
title: Plate - "City Hall, New York"
